name: PawGrid
tagline: The operating platform for independent pet-care businesses.
positioning: PawGrid consolidates booking, client records, and vaccination compliance into one system built for grooming salons, boarding kennels, and daycare operators.

hero.h1: Run your pet-care floor without the clipboard chaos.
hero.sub: PawGrid unifies appointments, client and pet profiles, and vaccination records so grooming, boarding, and daycare operators can manage a full book from one dashboard.

features.title: Smart booking grid
features.description: Drag-and-drop scheduling across groomers, kennels, and daycare rooms with buffer times, breed durations, and no-double-book guardrails.

features.title: Pet & owner profiles
features.description: Every pet's coat notes, temperament flags, feeding plan, and owner contact history in one searchable record your whole team can trust.

features.title: Vaccination compliance
features.description: Automatic expiry alerts and check-in blocks keep rabies and bordetella records current, so you're never chasing paperwork at the door.

features.title: Automated reminders
features.description: Cut no-shows with SMS and email confirmations, rebooking nudges, and deposit requests sent on your schedule, not manually.

features.title: Payments & deposits
features.description: Take card payments, store cards on file, and require deposits for high-value grooms directly from the appointment card.

features.title: Team performance
features.description: Track revenue per groomer, utilization by room, and rebooking rates with reports built for owner-operators, not accountants.

testimonials.quote: We moved off three separate tools and a paper diary. PawGrid caught 40 lapsed vaccination records in the first week and our no-show rate dropped by half.
testimonials.name: Marisol Reyes

testimonials.quote: The booking grid finally matches how a real kennel runs. Assigning runs, tracking feeding schedules, and billing per night all live in one place now.
testimonials.name: Trevor Halloran

testimonials.quote: Onboarding four groomers took an afternoon. The per-groomer reports showed me who was under-booked, and we adjusted the schedule the same week.
testimonials.name: Priya Nadkarni

pricing.blurb: For single-operator salons getting off paper and spreadsheets.
For growing teams juggling groomers, rooms, and boarding.
For multi-location operators needing central oversight.

homepage.footerBlurb: PawGrid is the operating platform for independent pet-care businesses — booking, records, and compliance in one place.
